question: Does the specified next-publication fixed-x membership gate separate the eleven named canonical omissions from their next publications in the same timestamp stream?

claims.text: Report exact symbols and full-point predicates for 24 named pairings: eleven canonical omissions, ten published self controls and three P224 opposite-sign sensitivities.

Any canonical omission admitting the held next-publication x contradicts membership alone as its reason for skipping under actual visitation, correct known screens, unchanged x until acceptance and no additional gate.
No inference of original visitation, x initialization, historical caller chronology, selector over all 69 broader positions or completion of the exhaustive commonality objective.

hypotheses.statement: The next published Gx was held unchanged while visiting the earlier named otherwise-qualifying positions since the previous publication in the same timestamp stream, with membership the sole acceptance gate at that stage.
hypotheses.mechanism: The first visited qualifying curve admitting y for the held x would be accepted; x changes only after acceptance. This is a conditional consistency model, without recovered initialization.

predictions.minimum_effect: Exactly zero lifts in the eleven canonical omission subset. Published self rows calibrate; the three alternate-sign rows are sensitivity only.

data_seen.measured: Earlier six final-curve point replays and ten self memberships were read before this model was chosen; this author has not evaluated the new omission pairings.

provenance.decisive_scope: The eleven new canonical omission plus next-publication Gx pairings only.

arms.description: One batch of 24 fixed membership rows plus full-point circularity diagnostics.
Exact repetition of the identical 24-row ordered batch.
p=101,a=-3,x=0: b=1,y=1 is a square and b=0,y=0 is the zero boundary.
p=101,a=-3,b=3,x=0 is a nonresidue; also source/schema corruption and full-point circularity controls.

positive.expected_detection: b=1 gives symbol 1 and lifts=true; b=0 gives symbol 0 and lifts=true through the same evaluate function.

null_population.description: The single predeclared exact nonsquare polynomial fixture y^2=3 mod 101; not a sampled historical population.
null_population.why_n: Exact detector correctness only, no frequency inference.

factors.name: pairing-and-inputs
factors.how: Pin all three input files, join full UIDs, seed, timestamp, ordinal, label and name; use stream slots as chronology and the next subsequent publication in the same stream.

factors.name: representations
factors.how: Eleven canonical omissions plus three predeclared P224 opposite-sign UIDs; keep x unchanged, do not transport x to -x.

factors.name: instrument
factors.how: Same stdlib Python source for every arm and frozen analysis; one thread.

factors.name: host-and-environment
factors.how: started.json records Python, executable, platform, machine, processor, source pins, Git head and dirty state. No clock or cost metric.

factors.name: order-warmup-layout
factors.how: Chronological stream order, A/A, planted fixtures; no warmup or timing estimand.

factors.name: prime-provenance
factors.how: Use exact archived known odd-prime field parameters; no new primality or order-certification claim.

factors.name: analyst-and-history
factors.how: Model chosen after earlier different final-curve replays were read; no masking. Historical visitation, initialization and absence of an extra gate are explicit assumptions.

factors.name: preemption
factors.how: No checkpoint restore; retain incomplete failures and do not interpret them.

comparisons.threshold: Canonical omission lifts must be zero for necessary-condition compatibility; any valid witness is a conditional obstruction.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Finite exact deterministic arithmetic with no timing estimand; retain chronological order and exact A/A.

seed_derivation.note: No RNG. The checker records integer 0 as a bookkeeping seed for every whole-batch arm; it does not generate inputs.

instance_sampling.rule: One fixed batch per arm. The 24 representation rows are correlated, not 24 independent samples. Selection is fixed before their new pairings are evaluated.

blinding.how: No masking; prior exposure disclosed and pairing/analysis frozen before new omission memberships.

power.note: Exact finite batch, no p-values, historical probabilities, confidence intervals or power claim. Alpha is schema bookkeeping. One valid canonical omission witness suffices for the stated necessary-condition test.

primary.name: Affine x lift count
primary.unit: completed rows admitting at least one y
primary.definition: Sum lifts=true in each arm; summary.json separately counts the eleven canonical omission rows. Zero RHS counts as a lift. Sign sensitivities never enter the main criterion.
primary.source: rows.jsonl lift_count; fixed-x.json rows[].lifts; summary.json canonical_omission_lifts

secondary.name: Completed arithmetic rows
secondary.definition: Number of rows carrying a completed lifts field, excluding nonarithmetic diagnostics.

stopping_rules.rule: One invocation, four whole-batch arms; main 24 and identical A/A 24 memberships plus the fixed fixture/control path. No outcome-dependent expansion.
Source/hash/UID/stream corruption, missing row, planted-control failure or algorithm disagreement invalidates interpretation. Preserve every row and log. No retries.
Supervisor watchdog of 60 seconds. A timeout is an incomplete observation, not mathematical evidence.

invalidation_rules: Unfrozen or unpinned protocol or instrument
Checker source, requested protocol or bound input differs from its bytes at the observed Git commit, or a required bound path is not committed inside the repository.
Published self or planted control failure

decision_rule.text: Report exact observations first. If valid, any canonical omission lift is a conditional counterexample to membership alone under the specified traversal assumptions. Zero witnesses is necessary-condition compatibility only. Report alternate signs separately. Full fixed(x,y) predicates are algebraically circular and supply no historical support. An invalid or incomplete run decides nothing.
decision_rule.statistic: Exact row vector and integer canonical_omission_lifts.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Exact number and full UIDs of canonical omission lift witnesses.

inadmissible: Treating 24 correlated representation rows as independent samples
Inventing or fitting initialization, visitation, point schedule or extra draws after outcomes
Transporting x to -x on alternate signs
Promoting fixed-full-point rejection on distinct b as historical support
Calling compatibility a selector for all 69 positions or completion of exhaustive commonality
Discarding failures or overwriting prior protocol or run artifacts
Any ECPP, VM, legacy-library, curve-runner, subgroup-attack or cost-claim execution

literature.claim: Read seed chronology, six May repeat-until-membership recipes and later four unknown point recipes; this does not identify omission point pairings.
Read directly: earlier final-curve replay observations differ from the new fixed omission pairings and informed this post-observation model choice.
Read directly: the documented standard and the unrecovered historical caller remain distinct.
Read directly: the bounded direct-byte search does not determine a point-to-omission assignment.

extensions.authority: Source-only draft; no approval, readiness claim or official transition.
extensions.export_unit: One whole-batch execution per arm, shared instance_id 0. Raw membership rows stay nested and correlated.
extensions.runtime_gap: Estimated total 60 seconds is an explicitly unmeasured conservative advisory allowance for the finite 24-row integer batch and controls, not a timing observation. Startup, host and Python overhead remain unknown; measured_on stays null. The separate 60-second process watchdog is a prospective process limit, not a scientific spending cap or mathematical stopping criterion.
extensions.retrieval_gap: search_knowledge unavailable; source records were read directly and the primary reconstruction retrieved.
extensions.bound_source_admission: Before membership evaluation, require the checker source, requested protocol and all three pinned input files to equal their exact bytes at the observed Git commit. The requested protocol must resolve inside the repository. Retain the frozen protocol hash, analysis and instrument source hashes, input pins and ancestral commit checks. Record the initial dirty state in started.json; unrelated dirty paths do not invalidate admission and are never modified.
extensions.freeze_authority_boundary: Frozen before new pairing data; no experiment approval, execution readiness or official scientific transition is asserted.
